t: The Git Main Branch Takeover: A Solo Dev's Guide to Repo Gardening
s: This article details a solo developer's 'main branch takeover' Git workflow, treating a repo like a garden. It covers decluttering, renaming local branches with force, synchronizing with remotes, and leveraging AI for efficiency, advocating for independence from proprietary tools.
sub: Git 'main branch takeover' workflow for solo developers
Repo gardening philosophy: decluttering and pruning unused files
AI code assistant integration and independence (Gemini AI, prompt engineering)
Local Git branch renaming and force-pushing to remote
Refined Git commands for upstream tracking and synchronization
